paxNotes.text: Solo: harga tier 1 pax sudah berasaskan bilik single occupancy — jangan tambah single supplement lagi. Flora Bay tiada harga tersiar untuk 1 pax (on request).
11 pax ke atas: tier katalog berhenti pada 10 pax, jadi kalkulator guna tier 8–10. Quote manual dan sahkan dengan operator. Private boat maksimum 12 pax sebot.

Kadar tidak tersiar (quote manual, sahkan dengan operator): tarikh peak Ombak & Flora Bay (amaun tersiar +RM150 dan +RM50 per pax per malam, tarikh tidak) · tambah-malam BASIC & Flora Bay · kurang-malam BASIC, STANDARD & Flora Bay.
Semak tarikh bertolak bukan dalam musim monsun (15 Okt – 15 Feb, pulau tutup). Marine Park Fee (katalog RM5/RM2 · RAW DATA PHT 2026 RM12/pax — sahkan) dan flight domestik tidak termasuk.

validity: Validity of Quotation: All prices are valid for 24 hours after quotation submission and are subject to resort and room availability as no space has been secured. Prices are quoted for 2 to 3 persons per room on a Default Standard Room basis. A deposit of RM 250 per person is required upon confirmation, with full payment due 30 days prior to departure. A late booking surcharge of RM 50 per booking applies to bookings made less than 45 days before the departure date. Boat timings are subject to weather and sea tide conditions; SIC tour and shared boat transfer are shared with other travellers. Marine Park Entrance Fees (Adult RM 5 / Child RM 2) are payable directly by guests at Kuala Besut Jetty. Perhentian Island is closed during the monsoon season from 15 October to 15 February and no trips operate on those dates. Triple sharing rooms with 3 single beds are provided subject to availability; an extra bed is added if no triple bed is available during the travel period. Itinerary, price and boat schedule are subject to change (weather, sea conditions, safety). Final itinerary and accommodation arrangements are confirmed 14 days before the trip. Any complimentary activity is non-exchangeable for other activities, vouchers or cash. Package is valid until 15 October 2026.
